explanation: Bartolomeo Cristofori built the instrument in Florence around 1700. Unlike a harpsichord, which plucks its strings, a piano strikes them with hammers, so players can play softly or loudly by touch.

claims.text: In Italian, piano means soft and forte means loud.
Piano and forte do not mean slow and fast, low and high, or short and long.
Bartolomeo Cristofori invented the piano in Florence around 1700.
A harpsichord plucks its strings, while a piano strikes them with hammers, letting the player vary the loudness by touch.
